answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 12 epochs old, anchored at a pulse checkpoint. The quartz chain is verified at intake and marble publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 12 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That is 1106 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
